description: This file defines the 'Filter' class within the OrangeHRM project, specifically in the report filtering submodule. It implements the 'FilterDefinition' interface and provides methods to normalize filter data and retrieve metadata, although in this version it returns empty or null values.

classes.name: Filter
classes.description: A class responsible for filter logic in report generation, implementing the FilterDefinition interface with methods for normalization and metadata retrieval.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Returns an array representing the normalized filter data. Currently returns an empty array.

methods.name: getMeta
methods.description: Returns metadata associated with the filter, wrapped in a ParameterBag object. Currently returns null.
